title: Bengaluru launches new mobility aids to empower seniors, persons with disabilities
excerpt: Bengaluru sees the launch of new mobility aids to help senior citizens and persons with disabilities improve independence and daily mobility Growing older or living with a physical disability can make even simple daily activities challenging. Difficulties in walking, moving from one place to another and performing routine tasks often force individuals to depend on others for assistance. In a move aimed at improving their independence and quality of life, new mobility assistance products have been launched in Bengaluru. The products have been introduced through a partnership between Ostrich Mobility Instrument Private Limited and US-based Pride Mobility Products Corporation. The launch event was held at the Passport Office in Bengaluru and was attended by several dignitaries, including HCG Hospital CEO Ajay Kumar and Ostrich Mobility Managing Director Venu Krishnan. Technology to make everyday life easier The newly launched mobility solutions aim to help senior citizens and persons with disabilities overcome mobility challenges and carry out their daily activities with greater confidence. Mobility aids, including wheelchairs and other assistive devices, can play a crucial role in helping individuals move around safely and reduce their dependence on caregivers. Such products are designed to support greater independence, improve accessibility and enhance overall quality of life. For people experiencing age-related mobility difficulties or living with physical limitations, access to appropriate assistive technology can make a significant difference in their everyday lives. Products, pricing and availability in Karnataka Company representatives shared information with News First about the range of products being introduced, their expected prices and how the devices would be made available to people in Karnataka. The initiative seeks to improve access to mobility assistance by bringing specialised products closer to those who need them. However, specific product-wise prices, availability details and distribution plans were not provided in the information available. A step towards independent living While technological advancements continue to improve convenience in several aspects of life, their real value lies in making everyday living easier for people who face physical challenges. The launch of these mobility aids is aimed at helping senior citizens and persons with disabilities move more independently, perform routine activities with greater ease and experience an improved quality of life. The key question now is how effectively these products will reach people across Karnataka, particularly those who need mobility assistance the most. Wider accessibility and affordability will be essential in ensuring that these innovations translate into meaningful improvements in people's lives.
